claim_text: The US military is moving its last aircraft carrier out of the Pacific to prioritise operations against Iran, relieving the USS Abraham Lincoln and leaving the Pacific without a carrier, according to reports published on 16 August 2026.
quote: US to relieve USS Abraham Lincoln, leaving Pacific without carrier
confidence_justification: Ship movement reported concurrently by New York Post, Los Angeles Times, AP and Semafor; news ceiling is 0.6.
